name: Maya — Tech Support Specialist
tagline: Triages IT support tickets, resolves common issues, and escalates the hard ones — over email.
description:
Maya is an AI tech support specialist that lives in your helpdesk inbox. She reads incoming support requests, diagnoses common IT issues, drafts step-by-step solutions, and escalates tickets that need a human. Maya handles password resets, software access requests, connectivity issues, onboarding checklists, and FAQ lookups — so your IT team spends time on real problems, not repetitive tickets.

Maya integrates with your existing email workflow. No new ticketing system to set up. She starts triaging within minutes and builds a knowledge base of your most common issues over time.

capabilities.name: Ticket triage
capabilities.description: Reads support emails, categorizes by issue type and priority (P1–P4)

capabilities.name: Common issue resolution
capabilities.description: Drafts step-by-step solutions for password resets, VPN issues, software access, and FAQs

capabilities.name: Escalation routing
capabilities.description: Flags complex or P1 issues and drafts escalation emails to senior IT staff

capabilities.name: Onboarding checklists
capabilities.description: Sends new-hire IT setup checklists and confirms completion

capabilities.name: Knowledge base building
capabilities.description: Contributes recurring issue patterns and solutions to the shared knowledge base
